text_en: David fled from Naioth in Ramah. He came before Jonathan and said, “What have I done? What is my guilt? And what is my sin against your father that he is trying to take my life? ”
text_cn: 达味由辣玛纳约特逃走，去见约纳堂说：“我作了什么事，有什么过错，哪里得罪了你父亲，他竟要害我的性命？”

text_en: He said to him, “Far from it! You shall not die. My father does nothing either great or small without disclosing it to me; and why should my father hide this from me? Never! ”
text_cn: 约纳堂回答他说：“决没有这回事，你决死不了。看，我父亲不论作什么大事小事，没有不告诉我的；为什么我父亲偏要对我隐瞒这事呢？决不会的！”

text_en: But David also swore, “Your father knows well that you like me; and he thinks, ‘Do not let Jonathan know this, or he will be grieved. ’ But truly, as the Lord lives and as you yourself live, there is but a step between me and death. ”
text_cn: 达味却对他说：“你父亲明知我在你眼里得宠，所以他想：不要让约纳堂知道这事，免得他悲伤。总之，我指着永生的上主敢在你前发誓﹕我与死之间只差一步！”

text_en: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever you say, I will do for you. ”
text_cn: 约纳堂对达味说：“你愿意我为你作什么？”

text_en: David said to Jonathan, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at the meal; but let me go, so that I may hide in the field until the third evening.
text_cn: 达味回答约纳堂说：“看，明日是月朔， 我原该和君王同席吃饭，但你让我走，藏在田野间，直到第三天晚上。

text_en: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me to run to Bethlehem his city; for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family. ’
text_cn: 如果你父亲发觉我不在，你应说：达味恳切求我，让他速回白冷本城，因为在那里全族举行年祭。

text_en: If he says, ‘Good! ’ it will be well with your servant; but if he is angry, then know that evil has been determined by him.
text_cn: 他若说：好！你的仆人就平安无事；他若勃然大怒，你就知道：他已决意行恶。

text_en: Therefore deal kindly with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a sacred covenant with you. But if there is guilt in me, kill me yourself; why should you bring me to your father? ”
text_cn: 望你仁慈对待你仆人！因你使你仆人因上主的名与你订立了盟约；假若我有罪恶，你可杀我，为何偏要将我交给你父亲呢？”

text_en: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you! If I knew that it was decided by my father that evil should come upon you, would I not tell you? ”
text_cn: 约纳堂答说：“千万别这样想！如果我确实知道，我父亲决意要加害你，我岂有不告诉你的吗？”

text_en: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly? ”
text_cn: 达味就问约纳堂说：“若你父亲严厉答复你，谁来通知我？”

text_en: Jonathan replied to David, “Come, let us go out into the field. ” So they both went out into the field.
text_cn: 约纳堂对达味说：“来，我们往田间去。”二人就往田间去了。

text_en: Jonathan said to David, “By the Lord , the God of Israel! When I have sounded out my father, about this time tomorrow, or on the third day, if he is well disposed toward David, shall I not then send and disclose it to you?
text_cn: 约纳堂对达味说：“上主，以色列的天主作证：明天或后天这时候，我探得了我父亲的意思，对达味有利与否，我必派人来告诉你。

text_en: But if my father intends to do you harm, the Lord do so to Jonathan, and more also, if I do not disclose it to you, and send you away, so that you may go in safety. May the Lord be with you, as he has been with my father.
text_cn: 倘若我父亲愿意加害你，我若不通知你，不放你走，使你平安离去，愿上主这样这样加倍罚我约纳堂！愿上主与你同在，有如曾与我父亲同在一样！

text_en: If I am still alive, show me the faithful love of the Lord ; but if I die,
text_cn: 若我那时尚在人世，愿你对我表示上主的仁慈；设若我死了，

text_en: never cut off your faithful love from my house, even if the Lord were to cut off every one of the enemies of David from the face of the earth. ”
text_cn: 望你不要由我家永远撤消你的仁慈！连当上主由地面上一一铲除达味的敌人时；

text_en: Thus Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, “May the Lord seek out the enemies of David. ”
text_cn: 若约纳堂的名字被达味家族消灭了，愿上主藉达味的仇人的手追究此案！”

text_en: Jonathan made David swear again by his love for him; for he loved him as he loved his own life.
text_cn: 约纳堂由于爱达味，再向他起了誓，因为他爱达味如爱自己的性命。

text_en: Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon; you will be missed, because your place will be empty.
text_cn: 约纳堂又对他说﹕“明日是月朔，因为你的座位空着，人必注意你不在，

text_en: On the day after tomorrow, you shall go a long way down; go to the place where you hid yourself earlier, and remain beside the stone there.
text_cn: 到第三天，人必更注意你不在；那么，你要到你曾出事那日藏身的地方去，坐在那石堆旁边。

text_en: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I shot at a mark.
text_cn: 到第三天，我要向石堆射箭，仿佛射靶。

text_en: Then I will send the boy, saying, ‘Go, find the arrows. ’ If I say to the boy, ‘Look, the arrows are on this side of you, collect them, ’ then you are to come, for, as the Lord lives, it is safe for you and there is no danger.
text_cn: 看我必打发一僮仆去找箭，假如我对僮仆说：看，箭在你后面，拾回来吧！你就可以出来，我指永生的上主起誓：你必平安无事。

text_en: But if I say to the young man, ‘Look, the arrows are beyond you, ’ then go; for the Lord has sent you away.
text_cn: 倘若我对僮仆说：看，箭在你前面。你就走吧！因为上主打发你走。

text_en: As for the matter about which you and I have spoken, the Lord is witness between you and me forever. ”
text_cn: 至于我和你现今所说的这话，有上主在我和你中间，永远作证。”

text_en: So David hid himself in the field. When the new moon came, the king sat at the feast to eat.
text_cn: 于是达味就去藏在田野间；到了月朔，君王入席吃饭。

text_en: The king sat upon his seat, as at other times, upon the seat by the wall. Jonathan stood, while Abner sat by Saul’s side; but David’s place was empty.
text_cn: 君王照例靠着墙坐在自己的位上，约纳堂坐在他对面，阿贝乃尔坐在撒乌耳旁边，达味的地方空着。

text_en: Saul did not say anything that day; for he thought, “Something has befallen him; he is not clean, surely he is not clean. ”
text_cn: 撒乌耳那天没有说什么，因为他想事情出于偶然，或许他染了不洁，还没有自洁。

text_en: But on the second day, the day after the new moon, David’s place was empty. And Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why has the son of Jesse not come to the feast, either yesterday or today? ”
text_cn: 次日，即初二日，达味的座位仍空着，撒乌耳就对儿子约纳堂说：“为什么叶瑟的儿子昨日没有来赴宴，今日又没有来？”

text_en: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem;
text_cn: 约纳堂答复撒乌耳说：“达味恳切求我许他往白冷去。

text_en: he said, ‘Let me go; for our family is holding a sacrifice in the city, and my brother has commanded me to be there. So now, if I have found favor in your sight, let me get away, and see my brothers. ’ For this reason he has not come to the king’s table. ”
text_cn: 他说：求你让我去，因为在城里我们要举行族祭，我的兄弟定要我去；所以，假若我在你眼中获宠，求你让我去，容我得见我的兄弟﹔为此，他没有来赴君王的筵席。”

text_en: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan. He said to him, “You son of a perverse, rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
text_cn: 撒乌耳对约纳堂勃然大怒，对他说：“娼妇的儿子！难道我不知道你同叶瑟的儿子一伙，甚至羞辱你自己，又羞辱你母亲的私处吗？

text_en: For as long as the son of Jesse lives upon the earth, neither you nor your kingdom shall be established. Now send and bring him to me, for he shall surely die. ”
text_cn: 你要知道叶瑟的儿子活在世上一天，你连你的王位都不得稳当！如今你差人去，把他给我抓来，因为他是该死的人。”

text_en: Then Jonathan answered his father Saul, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done? ”
text_cn: 约纳堂回答他父亲撒乌耳说：“为什么他该死？他作了什么事？”

text_en: But Saul threw his spear at him to strike him; so Jonathan knew that it was the decision of his father to put David to death.
text_cn: 撒乌耳就朝着他举起枪来要刺杀他，约纳堂便明白他父亲已决意要杀达味。

text_en: Jonathan rose from the table in fierce anger and ate no food on the second day of the month, for he was grieved for David, and because his father had disgraced him.
text_cn: 约纳堂就起来，气愤愤地离开了筵席；初二那天，也没有吃饭，因为他为达味担忧，又因为他父亲辱骂了自己。

text_en: In the morning Jonathan went out into the field to the appointment with David, and with him was a little boy.
text_cn: 次日清早，约纳堂按照他与达味的约会，往田间去了；有个僮仆跟随着他。

text_en: He said to the boy, “Run and find the arrows that I shoot. ” As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
text_cn: 他对那僮仆说：“跑去，找我所放的箭！”僮仆往前跑时，他又向前射了一箭。

text_en: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan’s arrow had fallen, Jonathan called after the boy and said, “Is the arrow not beyond you? ”
text_cn: 当僮仆来到约纳堂的箭所射到的地方时，约纳堂就在僮仆后面喊说：“箭不是在你前面吗？”

text_en: Jonathan called after the boy, “Hurry, be quick, do not linger. ” So Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows and came to his master.
text_cn: 约纳堂又在僮仆后面喊说：“赶快跑去，不要站住！” 约纳堂的僮仆就拾了箭，给主人拿来。

text_en: But the boy knew nothing; only Jonathan and David knew the arrangement.
text_cn: 那僮仆却不知道是什么意思，只有约纳堂和达味知道。

text_en: Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said to him, “Go and carry them to the city. ”
text_cn: 然后约纳堂把自己的武器交给跟随他的僮仆，向他说：“带回城去吧！”

text_en: As soon as the boy had gone, David rose from beside the stone heap and prostrated himself with his face to the ground. He bowed three times, and they kissed each other, and wept with each other; David wept the more.
text_cn: 僮仆走后，达味就从石堆旁起来，俯伏在地，拜了三拜； 以后他们彼此相吻，二人相抱对泣，达味哭得更甚。

text_en: Then Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, since both of us have sworn in the name of the Lord , saying, ‘The Lord shall be between me and you, and between my descendants and your descendants, forever. ’” He got up and left; and Jonathan went into the city.
text_cn: 最后，约纳堂对达味说：“你平安去吧！照我们两人以上主的名所起的誓：愿上主永远在我与你之间，在我的后代与你的后代之间！”
